about: Recall eval for the Telegram chat (tools/chat_memory_eval.py). Sixteen scripted conversations: twelve written 2026-10-08 before any run, and four (live-*) added that evening from the owner's live failure (memory on, a brand-new chat log, "before that" answered with the message just quoted), written before the fix's first run on them. Each seeds a chat through the inlet's own code paths, then asks one recall question of the live brain. Scored by code: a knowable case passes when the reply holds one of `expect` (case-insensitive); a case with knowable=false passes when the reply says it does not have it (ABSTAIN in the tool). Every name and word here is made up.
